verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents region-specific endpoints for the Voice Agent API: EU (wss://api.eu.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse), AU and India. Its compliance docs describe the EU endpoint as the option for customers who need data processing within the European Union, so users choose a region by choosing an endpoint. missing for 10: explicit statements that stored or retained data stays in the chosen region (the docs say "processing"), clarity on residency when third-party LLM providers are used, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
